name: Washita County, OK
findings: Washita County has 12 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, Washita County has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
67% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in Washita County list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 83% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?
